scope: Independent local browser and helper tests of the delivered RevisaWiki bytes

execution.actualLoaders: Both own and community loader, 6 cases and 60 checks each per browser
execution.nativeRegressions: 268 cases per browser, including classic, CodeMirror, 2017 source editor, Worker and staged fallback
execution.isolatedPackage: Helpers, full inline suite and both loaders rerun from a fresh approved-file-only tree in Chrome
execution.largeControls: Recorded native fixtures include a 1,910,746-byte article. Inline tests also include a generated section over 150,000 bytes.

boundaries.api: Read results and publication responses are local in-memory mocks. The loopback server refuses non-GET network requests and the fixture restricts external connections.
boundaries.publication: Production event.isTrusted, frozen source, identity, revision, preflight and single-submit checks remain enabled. Chrome and Firefox use trusted pointer events. Safari uses WebDriver Enter on the focused explicit button, which generates a trusted browser click.
boundaries.sourceAdaptation: Only exact known origin guards are changed in the served local copy to admit loopback. Original distribution SHA-256 hashes are recorded in every suite.
boundaries.privacy: Only approved source files and completed sanitized reports are selected. Diagnostic logs, incomplete runs, process inventory, profiles, screenshots and isolated work directories are excluded.

limits: A simulated publication proves the local request, guard and response flow. It does not claim an edit was sent to Wikimedia.
These are correctness tests. They are not a browser performance benchmark.
Repeated UI case executions and helper cases are not a count of distinct Wikipedia articles.
The separate article corpus and source-render checks are reported by their own manifests.
Earlier candidates, filtered diagnostics and withdrawn Safari lifecycle runs are excluded from final pass counts.
